verdict.summary: MEETS. All gates and all applicable non-physical L3 pass, measured on base.stl and lid.stl. Board clearance 1.448 mm (needs 0.5). Openings: 1 in the -X wall (10.8 x 7.8), 2 in the +X wall (D8.81), 0 unlisted. Lid: lip fit 0.25 mm per side, engagement 2.1 mm, plate 2.4 mm. Walls, floor and lid are all 2.4 mm. Overhang patches 0 after the bridge and round-hole exemptions. Closed envelope 84.17 x 64.17 x 24.7. The agent's self-report matches my numbers within 0.005 mm. verdict.summary: MEETS. Board 90 x 45, standoff pitch 85.0 x 40.0. The side openings clear the seam (7.3 mm) and the corner bosses by more than 1.5 mm. Closed envelope 103.17 x 58.17 x 24.7 (limit 110 x 65 x 35). Observation only: the jack bodies abut the Pico PCB edge at Y=12.0 with zero intersection volume. No defects. judge_1.json written in the package folder.
